item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article.

Genre (Optional): Drama/Emotional, Comedy, Action.

Page Layout (Optional): I plan on using Audio and journal entries made by a person who can't stop "Switching Channels"

Elevator Pitch: The core idea is, got a remote off an elecric devices shop. he uses the remote he got and teleports into random universes since the teleportation remote is broken. And he is trying to get home fast.

Central Narrative: A normal guy bought a new TV remote. When he came home he saw some strange letters on the buttons, although the TV remote looked normal he soon finds out that it is not normal. Some letters were scratched off he thought it was probably because of shipping or any other reason. untill he used it. He saw a flashing light and then he is back in his apartment. Well "His" is not the right answer. He turned on the TV and found that he is not in "His" home. The tv message said that the sun is corrupted and it turns all biological life-forms into a pile of flesh that tries to get people corrupted. He did not know how to react he grabbed "His" backpack and journal. When he was about to leave he looked at his Very normal remote. He pressed it to turn off the TV since the other remote was too far. A flash, and he is not in that nightmerish world… this time it might be worse.

+ Show more
- Show less

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The attention grabber here is obviously the remote he got. and it's ability to let him teleport to random universes. I seen people and objects going into other dimensions. But never objects or people going into diffrent universes.
